'''Tandin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|general]] who served the [[Royal Onderon Militia/Legends|Royal Onderon Militia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==

===Under the rule of Rash===
The leader of the [[Royal Onderon Militia/Legends|royal guard and native military forces]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]],<ref name="The Soft War" /> General Tandin was a proud patriot devoted to protecting the crown and the sanctity of the Onderonian people.<ref name="ency" /> When the planet sided with the Separatists during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="A War on Two Fronts">{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}}</ref> Tandin remained loyal to the crown<ref>{{SWE|1=locations|2=onderon|3=Onderon}}</ref> and supported the new king, [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]], despite his misgivings of offworld interlopers interfering in Onderonian affairs. The people of Onderon, though, began to reject Rash's rule, and an [[Onderon rebels/Legends|insurgency]] began targeting the battle droid forces stationed on the planet. Tandin had difficulty waging war against his own people, and cared little for the military support and tactical advice offered by the emotionless droids sent by the Confederacy to reinforce his defenses.<ref name="ency" />

===Liberation of Onderon===
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 44">{{FactFile2014|44|20 BBY 43-46|Liberation of Onderon}}</ref> Tandin attempted to convince Rash that the rebels were only targeting the droid army, and suggested that allowing the [[Royal Onderon Militia/Legends|Royal Onderon Militia]] to assume control of security could convince the rebels to stop and discuss terms. Kalani denied him, stating that the rebels may have had sympathizers among the militia's own ranks. Tandin insisted the threat was external and the droid reinforcements had done little to stop it. Rash interjected that they would not negotiate with the rebels, whom he referred to as "terrorists". Tandin then notified the king of [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]] and her brother [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw's]] involvement in the rebel movement, along with [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]], son of the [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]].<ref name="The Soft War" />

[[File:TandinSaw-TSW.png|thumb|250px|Tandin confers with the rebel Saw Gerrera.]]
Later that night, [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]], one of the leaders of the rebellion, was captured while attempting to rescue [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]] from execution. He was subjected to torture by Kalani to extract his cohorts' location. Tandin refused to have him tortured any longer and decided to have him alive in order to find rebels. In questioning the young man, Saw sowed the seeds of doubt within Tandin.<ref name="The Soft War" />
[[File:Tandin_holds_Rash_at_lance_point_Onderon.jpg|thumb|250x250px|Tandin rebels against [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]].|left]]
Later that day, Tandin witnessed the near-execution of Dendup and the occurrence of the rebels. When they were surrounded and all seemed lost, Tandin led all the palace guards to serve by his side and prevent the execution from happening,<ref name="The Soft War" /> thus the honorable general became an enemy of the crown.<ref name="ency" /> They surrounded the battle droids while Tandin took Rash as hostage for a short time. He gave the rebels and guards a chance to escape since he was willing to sacrifice his life for them. But before the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] were about to take aim, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] jumped out of the crowd and saved the [[General/Legends|general]] and both escaped, allowing all the civilians to turn against the false King Rash for his lies. In the [[Onderon rebel safe house/Legends|shelter]], Tandin and the royal guards pledged their support to the rebels and their true King.<ref name="The Soft War" />
[[File:DendupSpeech-TippingPoints.png|thumb|250x250px|Tandin at [[Funeral of Steela Gerrera/Legends|Funeral of Steela Gerrera]].]]
The rebels soon moved out of the city into the wilderness to draw the droids away from [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].<ref name="Tipping Points" /> Tandin threw his lot in with the rebels, bringing the forces of the royal army into the jungles.<ref name=":0">{{SWE|1=characters|2=dalgo|3=dalgo}}</ref> He consented to [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera's]] leadership when Dendup appointed her as leader of both their forces. However, Kalani dispatched droid gunships to aid the droid army to destroy the rebellion. The rebels were on the brink of defeat, until [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] delivered rocket launchers on behalf of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. They were able to defeat the droids, forcing the Separatists to abandon Onderon and kill Rash. Sadly, the victory was with great cost, as Steela died during the final battle. Tandin was present at her funeral in Iziz as Onderon celebrated its liberation.<ref name="Tipping Points">{{TCW|Tipping Points}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Tandin_hand_tatoo.png|thumb|100px|General Tandin's hand tattoo|left]]
A male Human,<ref name="The Soft War" /> General Tandin measured 1.77 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]<ref name="ency">{{SWE|characters|general-tandin|General Tandin}}</ref> and had broad shoulders. At the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he was a mature gentleman who sported grey, short-cropped [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and a wide mustache. His [[Color/Legends|blueish]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were surmounted by thick eyebrows.<ref name="The Soft War" /> Like other Onderonians such as King Ramsis Dendup,<ref name="FRconcept">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep503|text="Front Runners" &ndash; ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|slide 1}}</ref> the General had a personal lyra-shaped emblem [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] on the back of his hands.<ref name="SWconcept">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep504|text="The Soft War" &ndash; ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|slide 3}}</ref>

Tandin cared little for off-worlders, and despised General [[Kalani/Legends|Kalani]]'s soulless implacability.<ref name="SWE-General Kalani">{{SWE|characters|general-kalani|General Kalani}}</ref> While initially siding on King [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]],<ref name="The Soft War" /> he came to see the errors of his ways.<ref name=":0" />

==Equipment==
Tandin, along with the other Royal Onderon Militia members, wielded a [[Laser lance/Legends|laser lance]].<ref name="The Soft War" />

==Behind the scenes==
Akenathen Tandin first appeared in "[[The Soft War]]," the fourth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. He was voiced by [[David Kaye]].<ref name="The Soft War" />

In the [[Canon]] continuity he was given the first name of [[Akenathen Tandin|Akenathen]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]''</ref>
